usageNotes: Use this as a discovery call to confirm that the PDM SDN API surface is reachable and to enumerate available SDN sub-resources before drilling into zones, vnets, or subnets. No parameters are required and it is accessible to all authenticated users, so it is safe to call as a health-check or capability probe. The endpoint returns a directory index (null body per the spec), so meaningful SDN data must be retrieved from child endpoints such as those under /sdn/zones or /sdn/vnets.

examples.summary: Probe the SDN directory index to confirm API availability

tips: Returns a directory index with null body — do not expect SDN configuration data from this call; follow up with child-resource endpoints.
Accessible to all authenticated users (permissions: user=all), making it safe to use for capability detection without elevated privileges.
If this endpoint returns an error, SDN may be disabled or not licensed on the PDM instance.
